objective: Learn a projected-value to addressed-RWKV identity binder while retaining the causal-passing address-keyed DeepEmbed outer-FFN adapter.

authorization_basis.method_change: Preserve the warm-start address-keyed DeepEmbed path and add per-layer learned projected-value/RWKV pair maps plus a bounded identity gate trained with a matched-donor hinge.

architecture.identity_negative: same target projected carrier and projected slot value paired with a source-and-donor-disjoint matched donor RWKV state
architecture.identity_gate: sigmoid(4 * (score - 0) - 2) times bounded carrier-RMS recurrent direction

training.answer_objective: warm-start DeepEmbed answer CE plus active zero/donor/layer-permuted CE hinges
training.identity_objective: per-layer per-answer-token hinge(max(0, margin - correct binder score + donor binder score))
training.identity_state_gradient: live through binder and RWKV read

heldout_causal_endpoint.selection: Fresh source-and-donor-disjoint open-fit rows retained by the prior projected-value identity endpoint after its schedule and prior signed endpoint exclusions.

stopping_rule.training_failure: Do not interpret the endpoint; archive the signed failure.
stopping_rule.endpoint_pass: Authorize a separately locked native generation benchmark against projected-only and recurrent controls.
stopping_rule.endpoint_failure: Block generation and use the signed identity and CE margins to revise the binder, not its gain or duration.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.

claim_policy.endpoint_pass: May claim held-out learned projected-value/RWKV identity and teacher-forced causal preference on this open-fit endpoint.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden until a separately locked native benchmark beats the strongest projected/base model and recurrent controls.
